snippet.title: Emberville - Official Animated Early Access Trailer
snippet.description: To celebrate Emberville's launch into Early Access on October 27, developer Cygnus Cross and the animation house Spud Gun Studios ( https://www.spudgunstudios.com/, who also did the Baldur's Gate 3 animated shorts) have teamed up to create a fun new animated trailer. Check it out, and wishlist the Diablo-meets-Stardew-Valley game on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295170/Emberville/
